game_title: Split Join Assembly – Peak Beacon Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon, the beacon on the peak: the sherpa guide must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Split Join Assembly: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders.
theme: Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon: the beacon on the peak
core_gameplay_loop: In Peak Beacon, repeat each round: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the assembly value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the radio mast using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the radio mast is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Split Join Assembly
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Split Join Assembly' (Week 8 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Peak Beacon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how assembly changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Peak Beacon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 23.
